title: Phase 69 publishes thirty-two measurement contracts with zero values
summary: Thirty-two Phase 68 candidate measures now have exact public specifications and empty intake envelopes. Eight prospective break registers preserve ten break types and entity-specific stop rules without creating an observation, series point, admitted cohort, or outcome.
evidence_note: This release contains specifications, empty envelopes, prospective break rules, and synthetic-only validation. It does not contain a source attempt, artifact return, observation payload, value, receipt, actual break event, series point, cohort admission, trend, comparison, causal claim, or outcome.
publication_effect: Adds two Published briefings, one Published dependency map, one searchable registry with thirty-two detail routes, one public export, and reader-surface integrations while leaving all evidence and outcome states unchanged.
